# jamfplatform_pro_ldap_server (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro on-premises LDAP server by ID or by exact display name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. The data source never returns the bind password — Jamf Pro does not return it on read.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Admin identity and access | LDAP / cloud IdP | Read | `ldap-servers` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an LDAP server by its numeric ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_ldap_server" "by_id" {
  id = "31"
}

# Or by its exact display name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_ldap_server" "by_name" {
  name = "Corporate AD"
}

output "ldap_hostname" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_ldap_server.by_name.connection_settings.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) LDAP server ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) LDAP server display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_settings` (Attributes) Server connection settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_settings))
- `mappings_for_users` (Attributes) Attribute mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings_for_users))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--connection_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_settings`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Attributes) Bind account. The password and its rotation companion are never populated by the data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_settings--account))
- `authentication_type` (String) Bind authentication mechanism (`none`, `simple`, `CRAM-MD5`, `DIGEST-MD5`).
- `certificates_used` (String) Server-reported certificate usage summary.
- `connection_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait before cancelling a connection attempt.
- `directory_service` (String) Directory service type (`Active Directory`, `Open Directory`, `eDirectory`, `Custom`).
- `display_name` (String) Display name for the LDAP server.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP address of the LDAP server.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the LDAP server connection is enabled.
- `migrated_to_id` (Number) ID of the Cloud Identity Provider this server was migrated to, or 0.
- `port` (Number) LDAP port.
- `referral_response` (String) Referral response action (`""`, `follow`, `ignore`).
- `search_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait before cancelling a search request.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Whether the connection uses SSL/LDAPS.
- `use_wildcards` (Boolean) Whether partial matches are allowed in searches.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_settings--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_settings.account`

Read-Only:

- `distinguished_username` (String) Distinguished name of the bind account.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Always null — Jamf Pro never returns the bind password.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Always null in the data source.
